translation: It took place in the posad of Serock on 1 January 1890 at 11 AM. Personally appeared Izrael Ioskowicz, feldsher, 55, and Jankel Borensztejn, szkolnik, 40, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that on 30 December 1889 at 9 AM in posad Serock died Ruchla Malowanczyk, 61 years of age, daughter of the late parents Abram and Rifka, the [unclear: Litoszewicz/Antoszewicz] spouses. She left behind her husband [unclear name]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Ruchla Malowanczyk this act was signed by us and the witnesses. Civil registrar [signature].
